scope.token_definition: Recorded cumulative input includes cached context rereads; uncached=input-cached; not total cost.
scope.primary_arm_measure: Ratio of total Galaxy to total code tokens over eligible paired cells (aggregate consumption); the median of within-cell ratios (typical task) is a secondary measure.
scope.cluster_definition: BixBench source capsule; CompBio and IWC task
scope.pareto_definition: On common complete tasks: no other configuration has >=mean endpoint and <=median single-run input, with one strict improvement.
scope.caveat: Exploratory retrospective comparisons; unequal prompts, budgets and host/container policy; incomplete campaign/subagent usage.
